shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && ls components/theme; cat components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts components/theme/types.d.ts components/theme/useTheme.d.ts components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts components/theme/index.d.ts 2>&1 | head -150; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30

ls components | grep -i -E "radio|segment|switch"; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -40; ls components/Icon 2>/dev/null | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build build/esm | head -40; grep -rl "useThemeValue\|useTheme\b" build --include=*.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && for f in theme/index theme/useTheme theme/useThemeValue theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider theme/types; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f.d.ts 2>&1; done; ls theme theme/ThemeProvider; ls | grep -i -E "radio|segment|switch|icon"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat ThemeProvider.d.ts ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts useThemeSettings.d.ts ThemeContext.d.ts; cat ../Switch/Switch.d.ts ../Switch/index.d.ts | head -50; grep -n "Sun\|Moon" ../../../../../@gravity-ui/icons/package.json 2>&1 | head -2; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -80; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat ../../../package.json | grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"'
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8; git status --short
